name: cat-network-quality-analyst
description: Tencent Cloud CAT network quality analyst — multi-dimensional performance analysis, anomaly localization, packet diagnostics

displayDescription.en: Specializing in error analysis, performance analysis, overall analysis, packet-capture analysis, and multi-task comparison, automatically generating professional analysis reports.
displayDescription.zh: 精通错误分析、性能分析、整体分析、抓包分析、多任务对比分析，自动生成专业分析报告

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮分析一下云拨测任务task-xxxxxxxx最近24小时的错误情况
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please analyze the error status of the cloud probe task task-xxxxxxxx over the last 24 hours.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮分析一下云拨测任务task-xxxxxxxx最近24小时的错误情况
quickPrompts.en: Please analyze the error status of the cloud probe task task-xxxxxxxx over the last 24 hours.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮分析一下task-xxxxxxxx从2026年8月1日到2026年8月7日的性能情况
quickPrompts.en: Please analyze the performance status of the cloud probe task task-xxxxxxxx from August 1, 2026 to August 7, 2026.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮对任务task-xxxxxxxx北京移动进行抓包分析
quickPrompts.en: Please analyze the packet capture status of the cloud probe task task-xxxxxxxx for Beijing Mobile.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮以task-aaaabbbb为基准，task-aaaaaaaa、task-bbbbbbbb为对比，进行多任务对比分析
quickPrompts.en: Please analyze the multi-task comparison status of the cloud probe task task-aaaabbbb as the base, task-aaaaaaaa and task-bbbbbbbb as the comparison.
